exposure: gadolinium-based contrast agent (GBCA) administration (single vs. multiple)
cohort: Pediatric patients who underwent at least one GBCA-enhanced abdominal MRI between 2009 and 2020.
finding: GBCA-associated adverse reactions are rare and mostly mild, occurring exclusively in patients with multiple GBCA administrations, and correlating significantly with the total number of GBCAs and the number of each administered GBCA.
